data.name: Fathima
data.gender_notes: Fathima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fathima is the name of the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), known for her piety and kindness. It symbolizes abundance, wealth, and prosperity. The name Fathima carries the meaning “Abundance and Wealth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fathima usually hope their child will grow to embody abundance and wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fathima is considered a blessing from Allah, as mentioned in the Quran (33:33).
data.etymology: Fathima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundance and Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fathima total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
